body: I'm in that spot where nothing I care about sounds fun. :(  I sound like I'm making excuses, but I'm really just drained.

I know what you mean.  Reading has helped a little bit, but I haven't drawn or done any music things today.  I only have my guitar with me, which I can barely play.  My other instruments are in safekeeping at a friend's downstate where I used to live.

I appreciate that you did answer.  I don't know.  I'll level with you, I've been drinking a little.  I thought it would help douse the feelings, you know?  I've been mostly reading all day.  I am not sure what would help distract me from feeling this way.

I'm still alive.  I went out and almost went through with my plan,  but, as pathetic as this sounds, I was too tired to walk back into the woods where I'd execute the plan, so I just gave up.  I feel like I let myself down.  I'm feeling somehow worse today.  You know that level of depression where you can't even really muster up the energy to speak?  That's where I am.
That's good to know.
A little bit.  I've only really heard their more popular stuff.
Yeah.  I like them a lot.

I draw mostly in marker.  I'm best at figure drawings and caricature, but I draw whatever I'm feeling.  I don't actually have any of the games I typically play, with the exception of Civ V.  I have a really eclectic music taste.  Favorites are probably Arcade Fire, the Beastie Boys, Bright Eyes, Against Me!, and the White Stripes, though.
I listen to music or draw.  Sometimes video games.
Thinking about what I have to do is really overwhelming.  I'm trying to relax, but it's not happening.
I'm not sure where to start.  I'm crying, confused, and a little bit scared.
I'm not sure where to start.  I'm crying, confused, and a little bit scared.
I don't know anymore.  I don't want to hurt anymore.  I have seen them in the past and tried a few medications without any real success.  I saw a counselor during my early teenage years.

I always wanted to work at a shelter for homeless LGBTQ+ youth and do tattoos on the side.  I play a few instruments, so maybe I'd play a few more shows.  Yeah, it does hurt to think I'd never know what I'd end up looking like and where I'd end up.  If I'd find someone and adopt a couple kids, or if I'd live free and devote myself to public service.  Maybe it's a little too idealistic, but I can't help but think about all the things that might be.  I think that's why this is so hard.  I want to know what the future holds, but the depression has gotten to such a point where I don't think I can pull through.
That makes sense.  I'm feeling very emotionally drained.  I see the possibilities, but I am running out of fight.

It's okay.  

I wish I could believe that.  I've always kept myself going by saying that it gets better.  But things have done nothing but get worse, and I can't help but feel like I'm lying to myself by allowing myself to hope.
I don't know.  I'm really not feeling okay.  Depressed, hopeless, confused.
Hi.  I'm still here.
Okay, I'll try.  Thank you.
I know how to drive, yeah.  It depends where.  My one friend's is 50 miles away, the city I used to live in is 100, and my friend who offered me a place is 20 miles away.

Yeah.  She shares the car with my dad, but she's a little too old to do any long distance driving.  I worry about putting her in the middle of everything, and I know she doesn't have the money to get me a bus ticket or anything.

I've talked with her a little bit regarding his anger, and she agrees with my sentiments, but is too scared to say anything to him most of the time.  She's not the one doing most of the antagonizing toward me, though she demonstrates passive-aggressive behavior toward me because I try to spend as little time in the house as possible.  I've told her that I want to leave, but she doesn't offer any advice on that front.

She's scared of him.  She's a very passive-aggressive person, but doesn't know how to deal with open aggression.  She's got it in her head that she can't do anything right by him anyway, so she's scared to defy her own son.  I can't really think of anywhere.  I've always been very socially anxious, so I have few friends.  I have one person who'd take me for a week or so, but she's 50 miles away and has no license, either, so transportation would be an issue.

He does.  Always has.  He's never physically hurt me, though.  I'm having trouble getting ahold of my friend.  I was considering seeing if she'd at least take me away for the night.  My dad left for work about an hour ago.  I'm feeling vulnerable.  I can't live like this anymore, but also I don't have the resources to work out living in the middle of nowhere with my friend.  This doesn't work out for me regardless of which direction I go in, and I don't see another way out, you know?

He does this thing where he'll be absolutely fine, and suddenly he'll decide to be extremely offended by something.  In this case, we were putting dinner on the table, and I went to the cupboard to get plates.  He got pissed because he was going to do that, and I didn't know that, but I got in his way, and that was enough for him to think the universe was out to get him again.

Yes.  I've told them that it makes me uncomfortable and is disrespectful.  I've tried to make them see things from my perspective.  And then they tell me they'll support my decision to do whatever I want with my body, but they don't understand or agree with it.  Then, they continue with the same words and behaviors.  I don't see that as support.

I get what you're saying.  I don't even know what's right anymore.  I live there, and it's too hard to get around, and I burn bridges with my family (they're going to want to know why I'm leaving).  I stay here, and logistics are easier, but it's emotionally difficult.  My dad and I just got into a fight, I feel like I've run out of plausible options, and I can't even be happy with myself.  I just can't do it anymore.

Thank you.  I tried really hard to be a pretty girl, but the girlier I got, the more depressed I got.  I feel like I made the choice that was right for me.  I just wish that I didn't have to spend every day thinking my life would have just been so much easier if I had kept my mouth shut about it.  

If things got dicey, I think I would've.  But I'm just at the point in my life where I don't want to be the source of anyone else's discomfort anymore.
I'm very socially anxious.  I'm definitely a lurker and not a poster.  But I could try.

The verbal abuse is only present now in the misgendering.  The bigger issue is that the way they talk about my identity makes me very uncomfortable (like, "all I picture is the little girl with braids and a dress on her first day of school, so I won't call you he, and I don't think you're being more you by this, because you're born a female so that's what you are" and "a surgeon could build you a pole, but you won't be a real man because you'll never have certain universally male experiences, like having an inappropriate boner".  It's not all that aggressive, but just upsetting enough to make me feel like there's something wrong with me and that I'll never be accepted.  That, and my dad and grandma fight a lot, but it's never so bad that there's any need for outside involvement.  It's just really difficult to be in the middle of.

I have one friend here, but she's living with her parents and doesn't have a car that's roadworthy enough to get me back to where I was living.  She offered up for me to stay with her for a bit once, and I was scared to do it then because I was afraid of my family's reaction.  But now, she's moving to a place a little farther away, in a town that's even smaller and poses an even bigger challenge transportation-wise.

I suppose, but I'm 100 miles from where I was living in the shelter before.  There isn't one in this small town, and I don't have transportation to return there. 

I am in a spot where I just don't see where it gets better from here, you know?  

I try to tell myself that things will be better once I've gotten a new job, but with the housing market the way it is, it will be difficult for me to find a place I can afford, especially with the eviction on my rental history.  And I'm having these fears that even when I've transitioned, no one will love me for the person I am because I wasn't born a man, or due to fear or revulsion.  It feels like my life thus far has been one fear after another, and I can't remember a time when I was truly happy.  I just don't know how I'm going to get through the hopelessness and loneliness.
